meta.title: Event RSVP
meta.description: Create an event, share one link, see who's coming.

home.headline: Plan an event. Share one link. See who's coming.
home.explanation: Create an event in seconds — describe it in your own words and let AI fill the form. Guests RSVP from one link without an account, and you see the guest list and totals in one place.
home.previewCaption: What a guest sees after tapping your link. One page, one answer.

dashboard.title: My events
dashboard.step1Text: Fill the form, or describe the event in a sentence and let AI fill it.
dashboard.step2Text: Send the invite link in any chat. Guests don't need an account.
dashboard.step3Text: See who's going and how many people, in one list.
dashboard.sampleHint: The sample comes with five fictional guests so you can look around. Delete it when you're done.
